pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-edged polygonal patches with sharp, jagged edge gradients. Spatial area of patches is larger on the upper flank and becomes more condensed and smaller toward the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, mesh-like network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes consist of 3-way and 4-way intersections with consistent pixel thickness across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette of the mane along the upper neck and shoulder ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple vertical, light-toned linear streaks are visible on the mid-flank, indicating healed dermal scars or physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark, localized silhouette is present on the lateral neck, consistent with a perched oxpecker bird.
